text: Mei starts at the architecture firm on Monday. She's nervous because she hasn't done commercial projects before. Text her Sunday evening to wish her luck.
Xavier lives in Leith now, in a flat above a bakery. His partner Dalia works at the university hospital as a radiographer.
Luca handed in his notice today. His last day is Friday the 14th and leaving drinks are that evening at 6 at the Crown.

Call with Chen this afternoon. The client in Rotterdam wants the revised quote by Thursday at noon, and Chen's manager is breathing down his neck about it. He's been working until ten most nights and his wife Mei is fed up. I said I'd send him the updated pricing sheet first thing tomorrow so he isn't waiting on me.
Yuki got the promotion! Senior product manager from next month. I should send her something nice, maybe flowers to the office.
Lukas's dad is retiring after 32 years at the council. There's a do for him next Saturday afternoon.
Fiona has two boys, Kai and Tobi. Kai is nine and mad about football; Tobi is six and only eats pasta.
Joe's first day at the bank went better than he expected. His new boss seems decent and he's already been put on the mortgage team.
Need to book the car in for its MOT before the end of the month. Garage opens at 8 on weekdays.
Eva mentioned her sister Claire has just moved to Lisbon for a job with an energy company. Claire's husband is staying in Manchester until the house sells.

Dalia is struggling with the new rota at work. Nights three weeks out of four, and her mum isn't well either, so she's driving to Preston on her days off to help. She sounded exhausted on the phone and said she hasn't slept properly in a fortnight. Check in with her this weekend, maybe Saturday morning before she sets off.
Julien's leaving the agency. He's going freelance from January and seems really excited about it.
Aiko works in procurement at the hospital trust and lives out in Didsbury with her girlfriend and a very old cat called Biscuit.
Quick one: Thomas from accounts said the audit has moved to next Tuesday at 10. Hadiza will be presenting the figures instead of him.

Aarav has an interview for the head of data role on Wednesday at 2pm. He's been prepping all week but says he's terrified of the technical panel. Remind me to message him Wednesday morning, and then again in the evening to find out how it went.
Elena and her husband are celebrating their tenth anniversary in Florence in a fortnight. She says he still doesn't know what she's planning.

Hana's manager is leaving and she's been asked to step up as acting team lead from the 1st. She's not sure she wants it long term. She likes the hands-on design work and worries she'll end up in meetings all day. Her partner Kai thinks she should go for it properly when the permanent post is advertised in the new year.
Joseph is an electrician, self-employed, works mostly around Salford. Married to Niamh, who teaches at the primary on Elm Road.
The offsite with Bruno's team is cancelled, so Thursday is free again.

Damian finally heard back about the redundancy consultation. He's keeping his job but moving to the Leeds office in the spring, which means a much longer commute. He sounded flat about it. I should take him for a pint next week and see how he's really feeling.
Santiago mentioned his wife is expecting their second in March. Their eldest, Lola, starts nursery in January.
Asha is the new client lead on the Okafor account. She seems sharp. Meeting with her and Obi tomorrow at half 9 to go over the brief.
Don't forget to sign Ebony's leaving card before Friday lunchtime. Amy is collecting it from reception at 1.
Ricardo Bianchi, the new finance director, starts on the 3rd. He's moving down from Glasgow with his family.

Lunch with Xavier. His boss, Mrs Olsen, is retiring at Christmas and he's been hinting he'd like her job. Interviews are the week after next. He's never interviewed internally before and is worried it'll be awkward with the others in the team applying too. Mrs Olsen apparently told him off the record that she'd back him.
Luca says he's done with the restaurant trade. He's retraining as a plumber and the course starts on Monday the 6th.
Fiona told me her husband has been offered a job in Dublin. They haven't decided yet whether the whole family goes.
Remind me to ring Joe tomorrow after 5 to ask how his probation review went.
Eva lives in Bristol, works in comms for a housing charity. Allergic to nuts, which is worth remembering for the Christmas meal.

Tobi is leaving the shop floor and starting as a trainee manager on Monday. Says he's a bit nervous about managing people he used to work alongside. Want to send him a quick good luck text Sunday night.
Claire's partner, Aarav, works for the same consultancy as my cousin. Small world. They live in a converted chapel near Hebden Bridge.

Elena's daughter Hana has her graduation on the 19th at 11am. Elena is going up with her parents and staying the night. Hana studied marine biology and has already got a research job lined up in Plymouth starting in January. She wants a decent pair of walking boots for the fieldwork, which is a good gift idea.
Thomas's dog Pepper had an operation yesterday and he's been off work looking after her. I must text him tonight to see how she's doing.
Hadiza has gone part time to look after her dad after his stroke. She's still doing Mondays and Tuesdays. Her brother Obi helps out at weekends.
Our team away day is next Thursday, 9 till 4, at the hotel by the canal. I'm doing the icebreaker in the morning.
Joseph's mum turns seventy on Sunday. He's taking her for lunch, and Niamh said she's been dropping hints about a new garden bench.
Bruno, or Bru as everyone calls him, is the new ops manager. He used to run a warehouse in Coventry. Lives in Kenilworth with his wife and twin girls.
Got a voice note from Damian. The pitch to the Zhou group went really well and they want a second meeting next Tuesday at 4. Send him a congrats message and ask what he needs from me before then.
Santiago's stepdad passed away last weekend. The funeral is on Thursday at 2pm. I should send a card to the house tomorrow.
Asha said her flatmate is moving out at the end of the month, so she's looking for someone new. She works from home most days anyway.
Ebony Adeyemi starts her maternity leave on Friday. The team are doing a collection and a cake in the afternoon. Need to chip in for the voucher before Wednesday.
Amy has been really stressed about the restructure. Her role is being merged with Ricardo's and nobody has told either of them what happens next. Drop her a message on Monday morning.
Coffee with Obi. He's applying for the senior analyst post and the closing date is Friday at 5. He asked if I'd look over his statement tomorrow evening, which I'm happy to do.

Kai's girlfriend Yuki is a vet. They moved in together last year and now have a rescue greyhound called Dash. Kai works for the water company as a site engineer, mostly in Cheshire. His parents live in Osaka and he goes back every other Christmas.

Lukas told me his first week at the brewery has been chaos. Two deliveries went missing and his manager was off sick, so he ended up running the warehouse on day three. He's still glad he left the bank, though. His girlfriend Eva says he comes home happier even when he's shattered.
Dalia's sister Mei is getting married next June in Kyoto. Dalia is maid of honour and already panicking about the speech.
Note to self: client call moved to tomorrow at 8am because of the time difference. Set an alarm.
Julien Le starts at the studio on Monday. Ask him on Tuesday how the first day went.

Fiona said Chen is moving to the Singapore office in a fortnight. It's a promotion and he's taking his family with him. His kids will start at the international school after half term. We're doing farewell drinks next Friday at 6, and I need to book the table by Wednesday.
Aiko's retirement do on Saturday has been called off because she's had a fall and broken her wrist. Remind me to call her tomorrow afternoon to see how she's getting on.
Hana mentioned her uncle runs a ramen bar in Leeds. She worked there every summer through uni.
Ricardo's son Bruno has his driving test on Thursday morning at 9:40. Ricardo is more nervous than Bruno is.
Niamh got the deputy head job! She starts after Easter. She and Joseph are going out for dinner on Saturday to celebrate.
Elena runs the payroll team, has done for about six years. She lives in Harrogate and cycles in when the weather's decent.
Xavier's boss gave him a really hard time in the one-to-one this morning. He's thinking about looking elsewhere. He said he'd tell me more over lunch on Friday.

Busy week. Dentist on Tuesday at 4, the board presentation on Wednesday morning, and then Aarav's leaving lunch on Thursday at 12:30. Ask Claire tonight whether she's ordered the gift for Aarav yet, and remember to print the handouts Tuesday evening.
Mei is back at work on Monday after her knee op.
Amy's on leave until Wednesday, so chase Ricardo instead.
Bins out tonight. Recycling week.
Ebony said her nephew has just started his apprenticeship at the shipyard and absolutely loves it.
